one_month_reasoning: One scheduled event in the window: the Q3 2026 print on Tue 2026-11-10 before the open (guide sales $36-37M, non-GAAP GM 46.5-47.5%, opex $24-25M, EPS -0.20 to -0.12; Street $36.6M / -0.19). The record is 4/4 revenue beats (median +8.4% vs midpoint) and I expect ~$38M, but the call already said H2 is supply-capped, so the Q4 guide (~$41-42M implied by "about $135M" FY26 less H1 and Q3) matters more than the beat. Short-horizon set-up: the stock fell ~38% from $69.60 (insider sale price 2026-10-02) to $43.31 with heavy, steady insider selling (27 sales, $35.5M, no buys) and rising short interest (2.44M, 11.3% of float, up from 1.81M), so a clean beat-and-raise can squeeze, while a soft Q4 guide on supply would extend the slide. Net: median $44.0 (slight positive drift from the beat record and reversal after a sharp drop), split lognormal 25% down / 27% up for the month (annual 82% / 3.5 = 23%, widened for the print).

base.story: Median: Q3/Q4 2026 beat the guide modestly (supply-capped), FY26 $138.5M, FY27 $178.3M (+29%) as Oura/Pixel/WHOOP-class programs and Apollo5 upgrades carry the US book; opex +22% keeps losses near -$28M EBIT; the market keeps valuing AMBQ near the edge-AI/BLE peer median (~4.8x NTM sales).

upside.story: P90: supply constraints ease and the 3-5x-over-plan preorders at the newest customer convert, Oura (+74% revenue) and Pixel Watch volumes keep compounding, Apollo330+/510 Lite and Atomiq sampling (early 2027) widen the non-wearable funnel (25%+ of next-year designs), GM +1.5 pt: US +15%, China +10%, RoW +30%; edge-AI re-rating takes EV/NTM sales to ~8.3x (between AMBA and LSCC; AMBQ itself traded ~13x NTM at its $91 high). Moratorium high case +$0.82/sh.

sbc_treatment.note: Company non-GAAP EBIT excludes SBC (TTM $12.1M, ~11% of revenue); the set carries ebit_basis adjusted with sbc_treatment dilution and shares +2.5% a year. The EV/sales and EV/GP legs do not use earnings, so SBC enters only through dilution (and the cash roll does not deduct it, as it is non-cash). Peers on EV/sales need no SBC adjustment.

reasoning: Started from the thread quarterly driver set (5 drivers) and checked each driver against alternative evidence. Teardowns (iFixit Pixel Watch 4: Ambiq AP510 Cortex-M55; iFixit/Notebookcheck Oura Ring 5: Apollo3 Blue; TechInsights WHOOP 5.0: Ambiq M4) make the anonymous customers E/F/G look like Google/Oura/WHOOP-class programs (my inference, medium confidence); Oura's S-1 (+74% revenue, 3.6M rings TTM, 5M members) supports the set's +25% FY27 US growth, while its delayed IPO and a +4% smartwatch market (Counterpoint) are the warning. The Greenhouse board (46 roles, 43 engineering, 14 Singapore) supports the +22% FY27 opex path, so I did not take the faster-breakeven variant. TrendForce reports mature-node and packaging price hikes, so GM upside is limited. Positioning: 27 insider sales and no buys in 2026, short interest up to 11.3% of float, Stocktwits sentiment flipped from "extremely bullish" (May) to bearish. Sell side is far higher (avg PT ~$84-88) but I do not use it. Valuation: losses through FY29 make P/E and EV/EBITDA unusable (method-fit flag), so EV/NTM sales carries 75% (5 good peers, median 4.5x, k=0.8 exit 4.82x) and EV/NTM gross profit 25% (corrects for AMBQ's 48% GM vs 53-69% peers); net cash per share (~$11) is the floor. Result: research target (12m) $43.53, roughly the current price; P10 $23.64 (customer loss + de-rating to 2.6x), P90 $76.77 (supply unlock + edge-AI re-rating to 8.3x). The custom EV/GP leg is not driver-linked. Research was limited: X/Twitter, Reddit and LunarCrush gave no usable data; about a third of sources are in-lane because the inherited filing base (16 filings and data rows backing the driver set) stays cited.

model_inputs.ebit_basis_note: EBIT = company non-GAAP gross profit - non-GAAP operating expense - D&A = GAAP loss from operations + SBC + severance + IPO-related bonus and transaction costs - the 2025 non-monetary gain (Ex.99.1 reconciliations). Q2 2026: -8.727 + 3.557 = -5.170 = 15.989 - 19.374 - 1.785 [5]. The company's own non-GAAP figures exclude D&A as well as SBC, so its "non-GAAP operating loss" (GP - opex) is EBITDA-like; this set deducts D&A to keep EBIT an EBIT (engine ebitda = ebit + da = the company figure). EPS in notes = company non-GAAP net loss per share (excl. SBC and D&A, incl. other income) on weighted basic shares, the basis of the guide and Street (StockAnalysis/Benzinga). Engine model EPS = EBIT / diluted shares (no other income) and is lower; Zacks figures are on a different, GAAP-like basis.
model_inputs.sbc_treatment: excluded from EBIT (company non-GAAP); recorded per quarter in sbc; GAAP-basis readers must deduct it

quarters.note: FY = calendar year. Actual = FY2025 (10-K [8]) + Q1 2026 (10-Q, release [4]) + Q2 2026 (10-Q [6], release [5]). Q3 2026 (2026-09-30) prints Tue 2026-11-10 before the open (call 8:30am ET). To flip Q3 2026 to actual: set actual 7, overwrite column 7 of each driver (us_rev / cn_rev / row_rev from the 10-Q geography note, ng_gm, ng_opex) and constants da_c / sbc_c / capex_c / other_income, and add reported["Q3 FY2026"].
